name.value: Prince Cold Beer and Wine Liquor Store

description.value: Princeton Cold Beer and Wine is a liquor retail store in Princeton, BC, positioned directly off Highway 3 across from the Chevron station — a convenient stop for cyclists on the Crowsnest route. The store carries an extensive selection of cold beer, local and imported wines, and spirits.
